primary_analysis_family: source-verified study participant sample and comparator manifest
prespecified exact and near-identity sample-reuse audit
participant-aware within-study effects for verified contrasts
study-aware synthesis restricted to biologically compatible contrasts
primary_endpoints: change in apparent cross-study concordance after non-independent evidence and comparator mismatch are corrected
number and identity of gene or pathway signals directionally stable under all prespecified provenance-aware sensitivities

multiplicity.gene_level: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within each declared study-contrast family
multiplicity.pathway_level: correction within each declared pathway collection and contrast
multiplicity.cross_study: prespecified direction and effect-size stability with uncertainty; not nominal-P-value intersection

sensitivity_dimensions: shared samples retained versus removed or collapsed
correct comparator classes versus naive merged controls
participant-level versus naive library or cell-level inference where relevant
result-preserving platform and annotation harmonization alternatives
forbidden_without_reopen: direct raw-expression pooling across incompatible studies or platforms
